raj: Python snippet draft:

```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import time

client = RedwoodClient()

# resumable streaming + paginated retrieval
search_cursor = None
for page in client.embeddings.search_paginated("faq", cursor=search_cursor, page_size=50):
    docs = page.items
    # send docs as context to generator
    gen = client.responses.stream_generate(prompt=fmt(docs), resume_token=page.resume_token)
    try:
        for chunk in gen:
            print(chunk.text, end="")
    except ClientRateLimitError:
        # exponential backoff + resume
        time.sleep(backoff())
        gen = client.responses.stream_generate(prompt=fmt(docs), resume_token=page.resume_token)
        for chunk in gen:
            print(chunk.text, end="")
```

mike: tighten the example to use `with client.responses.stream_generate(...) as gen:` so it closes properly. Also show small `await gen.aclose()` in async TS.

jess: TS snippet (async iterator):

```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient();
for await (const page of client.embeddings.searchPaginated("faq", { pageSize: 50 })) {
  const resume = page.resumeToken;
  for await (const chunk of client.responses.streamGenerate({ prompt: mkPrompt(page.items), resumeToken: resume })) {
    process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
  }
}
```
